忍无可忍.pinyin: Zhè xiē huà tā tīng guo bù zhǐ yī cì wéi qí bù zhǐ yī cì cái rěn wú kě rěn
忍无可忍.en: He’d heard this more than once, but once was once more than he could bear.

战死.pinyin: Tā men dōu zhàn sǐ le
战死.en: They all died in the battle.

摩洛哥.zh: 我们球队有一个摩洛哥球员。
摩洛哥.pinyin: Wǒ men qiú duì yǒu yī ge mó luò gē qiú yuán
摩洛哥.en: Our team has a Moroccan player.

摩洛哥.zh: 阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥理论上仍处於战争状态吗？
摩洛哥.pinyin: Ā ěr jí lì yà hé mó luò gē lǐ lùn shàng réng chǔ yú zhàn zhēng zhuàng tài ma
摩洛哥.en: Are Algeria and Morocco technically still at war?

百合.zh: 百合的香气充满了整个房间。
百合.pinyin: Bǎi hé de xiāng qì chōng mǎn le zhěng gè fáng jiān
百合.en: A smell of lilies filled the room.
百合.es: Una fragancia a lirios colmaba la habitación.

百合.pinyin: Huā yuán lǐ quán shì zǐ bǎi hé
百合.en: The garden was full of purple lilies.

菲利普.zh: 菲利普有两辆汽车和一台摩托车。
菲利普.pinyin: Fēi lì pǔ yǒu liǎng liàng qì chē hé yī tái mó tuō chē
菲利普.en: Felipe has two cars and one motorcycle.
菲利普.es: Felipe tiene dos carros y una moto.

菲利普.zh: 他是英国人所知的菲利普国王。
菲利普.pinyin: Tā shì yīng guó rén suǒ zhī de fēi lì pǔ guó wáng
菲利普.en: He was known to the English as King Philip.

菲利普.zh: 菲利普不喜欢客场比赛，他总是容易感到很疲惫。
菲利普.pinyin: Fēi lì pǔ bù xǐ huan kè chǎng bǐ sài tā zǒng shì róng yì gǎn dào hěn pí bèi
菲利普.en: Philip hates traveling for away games. He always gets really tired and never plays well.

通通.pinyin: Tā tōng tōng dōu chī le

通通.zh: 感谢您终於为我说明了为甚么人们通通把我当傻瓜。
通通.pinyin: Gǎn xiè nín zhōng yú wèi wǒ shuō míng le wèi shèn má rén men tōng tōng bǎ wǒ dāng shǎ guā
通通.en: Thanks for having explained to me at last why people take me for an idiot.
通通.es: Gracias por explicarme por fin por qué la gente me toma por un idiota.

首府.zh: 凤凰城是亚利桑那州的首府。
首府.pinyin: Fèng huáng chéng shì yà lì sāng nà zhōu de shǒu fǔ
首府.en: Phoenix is the capital of Arizona.
首府.es: Phoenix es la capital de Arizona.

首府.zh: 一场毁灭性的地震袭击了这个州的首府。
首府.pinyin: Yī chǎng huǐ miè xìng de dì zhèn xí jī le zhè ge zhōu de shǒu fǔ
首府.en: A devastating earthquake hit the state capital.

首府.zh: 兰辛是密西根州的首府。
首府.pinyin: Lán xīn shì mì xī gēn zhōu de shǒu fǔ
首府.en: Lansing is the state capital of Michigan.

一朝一夕.zh: 学习语言永远不是一朝一夕的事。
一朝一夕.pinyin: Xué xí yǔ yán yǒng yuǎn bù shì yī zhāo yī xī de shì
一朝一夕.en: Whatever language you study, it takes time.
一朝一夕.es: Cualquier idioma que estudies, toma tiempo.

一朝一夕.zh: 英语不是一朝一夕就能学会的。
一朝一夕.pinyin: Yīng yǔ bù shì yī zhāo yī xī jiù néng xué huì de

上市.zh: 这家公司在巴黎证券交易所上市了。
上市.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī zài bā lí zhèng quàn jiāo yì suǒ shàng shì le
上市.en: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.

以色列.pinyin: Wǒ zài yǐ sè liè chū shēng le
Wǒ lái zì yǐ sè liè

侵略者.pinyin: Qīn lüè zhě zhù dìng yào bèi dǎ bài
侵略者.en: The aggressors are bound to be defeated.
侵略者.es: A los agresores solo les queda darse por vencidos.

做为.zh: 我家院子和邻居家院子之间有一道篱笆做为分界线。。
做为.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yuàn zi hé lín jū jiā yuàn zi zhī jiān yǒu yī dào lí ba zuò wéi fēn jiè xiàn
做为.en: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.

做为.zh: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图。
做为.pinyin: Xuǎn zé hé shì de wèi xīng tú zuò wéi dǐ tú
做为.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.

全球变暖.zh: 海面随着全球变暖的加剧而越来越高。
全球变暖.pinyin: Hǎi miàn suí zhe quán qiú biàn nuǎn de jiā jù ér yuè lái yuè gāo
全球变暖.en: As global warming increases, sea levels get higher and higher.

全球变暖.zh: 全球变暖让科学家担心。
全球变暖.pinyin: Quán qiú biàn nuǎn ràng kē xué jiā dān xīn

公休.zh: 可是肉店今天公休没办法。
公休.pinyin: Kě shì ròu diàn jīn tiān gōng xiū méi bàn fǎ
公休.en: But the butcher is observing the holiday today, there's nothing we can do about it.

刚强.zh: 父亲一生刚强，最痛恨的就是儿子活成个窝囊废的样子。
刚强.pinyin: Fù qīn yī shēng gāng qiáng zuì tòng hèn de jiù shì ér zi huó chéng gè wō nang fèi de yàng zi
刚强.en: The father was strong all his life, and what he hated most was seeing his son live like a loser.

势均力敌.zh: 在打网球方面，他和我势均力敌。
势均力敌.pinyin: Zài dǎ wǎng qiú fāng miàn tā hé wǒ shì jūn lì dí
势均力敌.en: He is a good match for me in tennis.

同岁.es: Tiene la misma edad que yo.

同岁.pinyin: Nà liǎng gè xiǎo hái tóng suì
同岁.en: Those two children were the same age.
同岁.es: Esos dos niños tenían la misma edad.

大胃王.pinyin: Tā shì gè dà wèi wáng

大胃王.zh: 我就只告诉你，他是个大胃王。
大胃王.pinyin: Wǒ jiù zhǐ gào su nǐ tā shì gè dà wèi wáng
大胃王.en: This is just between you and me, he is a big eater.

密室.zh: 在城堡最秘密的密室里有全球宝中之宝——《真理经》。
密室.pinyin: Zài chéng bǎo zuì mì mì de mì shì lǐ yǒu quán qiú bǎo zhōng zhī bǎo zhēn lǐ jīng
密室.en: In the most secret chamber of the castle lay the greatest treasure on earth—the Book of Truth.
密室.es: En la cámara más secreta del castillo se encontraba el mayor tesoro sobre la tierra: el Libro de la Verdad.

密室.zh: 我完全是在偶然的情况下发现了密室。
密室.pinyin: Wǒ wán quán shì zài ǒu rán de qíng kuàng xià fā xiàn le mì shì
密室.en: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.

富翁.zh: 如果当时买了那幅画，我现在就是一个富翁了。
富翁.pinyin: Rú guǒ dāng shí mǎi le nà fú huà wǒ xiàn zài jiù shì yī ge fù wēng le
富翁.en: If I had bought the painting then, I would be rich now.
富翁.es: Si hubiera comprado la pintura entonces, ahora sería rico.

富翁.zh: 她凭著努力和生意头脑成了富翁。
富翁.pinyin: Tā píng zhe nǔ lì hé shēng yì tóu nǎo chéng le fù wēng
富翁.en: She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.

崎.zh: 尾崎将司是日本最受欢迎的专业高尔夫球手。
崎.pinyin: Wěi qí jiāng sī shì rì běn zuì shòu huān yíng de zhuān yè gāo ěr fū qiú shǒu
崎.en: No pro golfer in Japan is as popular as Jumbo Ozaki.

布谷鸟.zh: 人们把这种鸟叫做布谷鸟。
布谷鸟.pinyin: Rén men bǎ zhè zhǒng niǎo jiào zuò bù gǔ niǎo
布谷鸟.en: People call this kind of bird a cuckoo.

布谷鸟.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng niǎo bèi chēng wéi bù gǔ niǎo
布谷鸟.en: This bird is known as a cuckoo.

庆祝会.zh: 我没请他来参加庆祝会，感到有点内疚。
庆祝会.pinyin: Wǒ méi qǐng tā lái cān jiā qìng zhù huì gǎn dào yǒu diǎn nèi jiù
庆祝会.en: I feel a little guilty that I didn't invite him to join the celebration.

意志力.pinyin: Nǐ de yì zhì lì hěn jiàng
意志力.en: You've got a lot of willpower.

意志力.zh: 他仅凭借精神力量和意志力就达到了他所想要的生活。
意志力.pinyin: Tā jǐn píng jiè jīng shén lì liang hé yì zhì lì jiù dá dào le tā suǒ xiǎng yào de shēng huó
意志力.en: He got where he wanted to be in life by just using his raw mental strength and willpower.

愚人.zh: 可惜，世界上的愚人总比聪明人要多。
愚人.pinyin: Kě xī shì jiè shàng de yú rén zǒng bǐ cōng ming rén yào duō
愚人.en: What a pity that there are more foolish people than smart ones.
愚人.es: Es una pena que en este mundo los estúpidos son muchos más que los inteligentes.

愚人.zh: 天使畏惧处, 愚人敢闯入。
愚人.pinyin: Tiān shǐ wèi jù chǔ yú rén gǎn chuǎng rù
愚人.en: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
愚人.es: Los necios se apresuran a entrar donde los ángeles temen pisar.

慈善机构.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。
慈善机构.pinyin: Tāng mǔ juān yī bàn tā de xīn shuǐ gěi tā zuì xǐ huan de cí shàn jī gòu
慈善机构.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.

慈善机构.zh: 我一得到一大笔钱就捐一部分给慈善机构。
慈善机构.pinyin: Wǒ yī dé dào yī dà bǐ qián jiù juān yī bù fen gěi cí shàn jī gòu
慈善机构.en: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.

慎.pinyin: Shèn yě qǔ le gè piào liang gū niang

挥之不去.zh: 那首歌在我脑中挥之不去。
挥之不去.pinyin: Nà shǒu gē zài wǒ nǎo zhōng huī zhī bù qù
挥之不去.en: I can't get that song out of my head.
挥之不去.es: No puedo quitarme esa canción de mi cabeza.

挥之不去.zh: 他尖刻的话语仍然在我心中挥之不去。
挥之不去.pinyin: Tā jiān kè de huà yǔ réng rán zài wǒ xīn zhōng huī zhī bù qù
挥之不去.en: His bitter words still rankle in my mind.

攀升.zh: 事实上，价格每个星期都在攀升。
攀升.pinyin: Shì shí shàng jià gé měi ge xīng qī dōu zài pān shēng
攀升.en: As it is, prices are going up every week.
攀升.es: La verdad es que los precios están subiendo cada semana.

攀升.zh: 价格一直在稳定地攀升。
攀升.pinyin: Jià gé yī zhí zài wěn dìng de pān shēng

斜对.zh: 有一家便利店在马路斜对面。
斜对.pinyin: Yǒu yī jiā biàn lì diàn zài mǎ lù xié duì miàn
斜对.en: There's a convenience store diagonally across the street.

时好时坏.zh: 我父亲的状况时好时坏。
时好时坏.pinyin: Wǒ fù qīn de zhuàng kuàng shí hǎo shí huài
时好时坏.en: My father's condition seems to improve one moment, but the next moment he sinks again.

水母.zh: 渔民用他的网捕到了一只紫色的水母。
水母.pinyin: Yú mín yòng tā de wǎng bǔ dào liǎo yī zhǐ zǐ sè de shuǐ mǔ
水母.en: The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.

水泥地.pinyin: Bié zuò zài shuǐ ní dì shàng
水泥地.en: Don't sit on the cement floor.

水泥地.pinyin: Bié tǎng zài shuǐ ní dì shàng
水泥地.en: Don't lie on the cement floor.

求学.zh: 汤姆不想在波士顿求学。
求学.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bù xiǎng zài bō shì dùn qiú xué
求学.en: Tom doesn't want to study in Boston.

沐浴露.pinyin: Wǒ bù yòng mù yù lù

注音.zh: 请为这本书加上假名注音。
注音.pinyin: Qǐng wèi zhè běn shū jiā shàng jiǎ míng zhù yīn
注音.en: Please add furigana to this book.

注音.pinyin: Zěn me jiā jiǎ míng zhù yīn

消散.zh: 她开始在我的记忆中消散。
消散.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ zài wǒ de jì yì zhōng xiāo sàn
消散.en: She had begun to recede in my memory.

消散.zh: 我对於她的记忆开始消散。
消散.pinyin: Wǒ duì yú tā de jì yì kāi shǐ xiāo sàn
消散.en: My memory of her has begun to recede.

猎.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì liè lù qù le
猎.en: Tom and Mary went deer hunting.
猎.es: Tom y Mary fueron a cazar ciervos.

疤痕.zh: 他额头上的疤痕很醒目。
疤痕.pinyin: Tā é tóu shàng de bā hén hěn xǐng mù
疤痕.en: The scar on his forehead really stands out.
疤痕.es: La cicatriz en su frente resalta.

疤痕.zh: 你的爱情留下的疤痕使我想起我们。
疤痕.pinyin: Nǐ de ài qíng liú xià de bā hén shǐ wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ men
疤痕.en: The scars of your love remind me of us.

脸蛋.zh: 凉子有一张漂亮的小脸蛋。
脸蛋.pinyin: Liáng zi yǒu yī zhāng piào liang de xiǎo liǎn dàn
脸蛋.en: Ryoko has a cute little face.

自私自利.zh: 他只不过是个自私自利的人。
自私自利.pinyin: Tā zhǐ bu guò shì gè zì sī zì lì de rén
自私自利.en: He is nothing more than an egoist.
自私自利.es: Él no es más que un egoísta.

自私自利.zh: 他是个极其自私自利的人。
自私自利.pinyin: Tā shì gè jí qí zì sī zì lì de rén
自私自利.en: He is a lump of selfishness.

许下.zh: 你有没有许下什么新年愿望？
许下.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xǔ xià shén me xīn nián yuàn wàng
许下.en: Have you made any New Year's resolutions?

许下.zh: 小朋友们经常给圣诞老人写信，许下自己的愿望。
许下.pinyin: Xiǎo péng yǒu men jīng cháng gěi shèng dàn lǎo rén xiě xìn xǔ xià zì jǐ de yuàn wàng
许下.en: Children often send letters to Santa with their wishes.

赢家.pinyin: Zuò gè yíng jiā hěn hǎo
赢家.en: It is good to be a winner.

赢家.pinyin: Lì shǐ yóu yíng jiā shū xiě
赢家.en: History is written by the victors.
赢家.es: La historia la escribe el cazador, no la liebre.

转向.pinyin: Wǒ zài xiǎo xiàng zi lǐ zhuǎn xiàng le
转向.en: I turned into a small alleyway.

转向.zh: 萨米的车突然转向，加速驶去。
转向.pinyin: Sà mǐ de chē tū rán zhuǎn xiàng jiā sù shǐ qù
转向.en: Sami's car suddenly veered off, speeding away.

靠窗.pinyin: Wǒ yào yī zhāng kào chuāng de zhuō zi
靠窗.en: I'd like a table by the window.
靠窗.es: Quisiera una mesa junto a la ventana.

靠窗.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng kào chuāng hái shi zǒu láng
靠窗.en: Would you like a window or aisle seat?

黎.zh: 以兖衣为褋兮，以黎邱为墟。
黎.pinyin: Yǐ yǎn yī wèi xī yǐ lí qiū wèi xū
黎.en: I use Yan garments as my plain robe, and turn Liqiu into ruins.

一级.pinyin: Tā de jūn jiē bǐ wǒ gāo yī jí
一级.en: He is immediately above me in rank.

上层.zh: 强盗似乎是在上层破窗而入的。
上层.pinyin: Jiàng dào sì hū shì zài shàng céng pò chuāng ér rù de
上层.en: It seems that the burglar broke in through an upstairs window.

下订单.zh: 您决定好要下订单了吗？
下订单.pinyin: Nín jué dìng hǎo yào xià dìng dān le ma
下订单.en: Are you ready to order now?
